transcript.text: And that's the agent's own steps. Each tool call shows up as a child span under the request, so you can see which tool was slow.

knowledge.title: Traces across services
knowledge.text: Arize tracing uses standard OpenTelemetry context propagation: when the calling service and the called service are both instrumented, the trace context passed between them links their spans into one trace.
